ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a purpose literal outside the census (`zp-extra-thing-v1`) is presented
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the purpose census is closed; an unlisted literal has no verification path

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a C4-deferred implementer tuple is treated as a frozen verification target
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: zp-implementer-* field sequences and goldens are deferred (C4); only architecture exists

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a legacy zupay push purpose is verified on the v2 suite path
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: cross-purpose verification rejects; legacy push literals never verify as suite tuples (A.9 #10)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: inner keys reordered (reversed sequence)
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the 14-position inner field sequence is frozen; any reorder changes the signed bytes (A.9 #1)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a required inner field is dropped
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: all 12 required fields are always present; a missing field fails closed (A.9 #1)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an unknown top-level inner field is added
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: unknown top-level inner fields fail closed until a future protocol version supports them (protocol rule 3)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: `message` is placed before `expiry__unix_time_secs`
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the two optional fields are trailing-only, expiry before message (protocol rule 3; A.1.2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: the domain-separation prefix differs from payload field 1
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: purpose appears twice by design; both copies must equal the expected literal (A.9 #2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a trailing LF (or BOM/whitespace) is appended to the preimage
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: no BOM, trailing newline, or insignificant whitespace (A.9 #8)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: transfer_code_sha256 is computed after URL/base64 decode or padding repair
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the digest input is the exact stored string bytes, never preprocessed (A.9 #11)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: canonical_version is the string "1" instead of the number 1
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: canonical_version is the JSON number 1 only (A.9 #3)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: the SplitChain inner `version` is the number 2 instead of the string "2"
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the inner version literal is the string "2" (protocol rule 3 position 2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a funded sender presents an empty genesis predecessor in a re-signed RECEIVE target
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: fails as funded-sender/genesis-predecessor during sender preflight, before co-sign or submit (A.9 #17)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a genesis link ("") is asserted for a wallet with settled history
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: the chain link is the most recent settled step_2_signature; genesis is "" only with no history (protocol rule 1.5)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a UUID field uses uppercase spelling
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: UUIDs are lowercase canonical strings (A.9 #4)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a public key/signature loses its canonical base64url padding
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: canonical padded base64url only; unpadded or non-canonical re-encode rejects (A.9 #5)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an amount field is a JSON number (or exponent/signed/leading-zero/>32dp string)
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: amounts are canonical decimal strings (A.9 #6)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a timestamp lacks exactly three fractional digits or the trailing Z
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: canonical timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 with exactly three fractional digits (A.9 #7)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an NFC form is substituted by NFD (or vice versa) in a UTF-8 string field
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: no Unicode normalization; the signed bytes change and reject (A.9 #9)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: expires_at is more than 300 seconds after the signed issued_at on a ceremony tuple
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: 0 < expires_at − issued_at ≤ 300s, checked against the signed issued_at (A.4.1-A.4.3)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: raw gateway envelope bytes are mutated and the change alters preimage verification
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: envelope mutation never changes signed-preimage verification; changed bytes are retained as distinct evidence, EQUIVALENT_STATE_DIFFERENT_ENVELOPE when the semantic head is unchanged (protocol rule 10 v11)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: the queried wallet is BOTH step-1 and step-2 party
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: exactly one role predicate must hold; self-transfers are rejected (protocol rule 5)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: the queried wallet is NEITHER step-1 nor step-2 party
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: a wallet absent from both positions is rejected (protocol rule 5)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: the receiver's previous_step_2_state_signature is hard-coded for a sender-side observation
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: P reads the role's own side of the inner; cross-role substitution is forbidden (protocol rule 5)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a 403 `forbidden`/`insufficient_scope` auth-error code is reintroduced
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: scope denial collapses to the generic 401 invalid_api_key; the 403 auth code is a scope oracle

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an amount request field is sent as a JSON number
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: JSON numbers are rejected for all amount fields (API 1)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an amount string carries a leading zero (`01.5`)
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: ZkzAmount forbids leading zeros (protocol rule 2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an amount string uses exponent notation (`1e2`)
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: ZkzAmount forbids exponents (protocol rule 2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: an amount string carries 33 decimal places
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: ZkzAmount allows at most 32 decimals (protocol rule 2)

ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.mutation: a Uuid is uppercased or otherwise alternately spelled
ADVERSARIAL_FIXTURES.rejectionReason: APIs reject alternate UUID spellings (protocol rule 2)
